Game Overview

Kuma Bear is a adventure title where embark on a delightful 2D platforming journey as a playful bear in Kuma Bear. Navigate through eight progressively challenging levels, mastering precise jumps and clever maneuvers to outsmart foes and collect irresistible chocolates. With intuitive controls and escalating trials, relish the joy of overcoming obstacles on your quest home.
